mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_credential (user_id, password_hash, password_salt) VALUES (#{userId}, #{passwordHash}, #{passwordSalt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE password_hash = VALUES(password_hash), password_salt = VALUES(password_salt), failed_count = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE user_credential SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_salt = #{passwordSalt}, failed_count = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_credential SET failed_count = #{failedCount}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_credential SET failed_count = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
